unit.why: A one-line anecdote in a numbered series of praises of the Berditchever: while reciting the blessing over the Megillah reading he danced on the reader's stand and almost onto the scroll.
unit.boundary_note: Part of a numbered series of short anecdotes (ז, ח, ט) about the same tzaddik; this item is self-contained.

stories.start_quote: (ח) בעת בירך ברכת על מקרא מגלה

stories.summary_en: When the tzaddik (R. Levi Yitzhak of Berditchev, by context) recited the blessing over the Megillah reading, he danced on the reader's stand and almost onto the scroll itself.
